description:
Remove the `PROFILE_NOT_FOUND` error code, which no route reaches, or make it reachable where it belongs.

## Background

An absent package directory returns `PROFILE_ERROR` with exit 1 (surfaced by 1a989754 and again by 0f648627). `PROFILE_NOT_FOUND` has no reachable route, and the `NotFoundError` branch in `crates/jit/src/output/failure.rs` serves only it.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] REQ-01: `PROFILE_NOT_FOUND` either no longer exists, with its failure branch and generated error-code reference entry removed, or an absent package directory reports it with a test proving so. One outcome, with net-negative production lines preferred.
- [hard] REQ-02: An absent package directory reports one error code, with an actionable message naming the path.
title: Settle the unreachable PROFILE_NOT_FOUND code
